title: Currency conversion and display
pinpoint: money.py with format_money(cents, currency) and convert(amount_cents, src, dst)
acceptance: format_money(123456, 'USD') returns '$1,234.56'; EUR uses the euro sign and the same grouping: '€1,234.56'
format_money handles zero and negative amounts: 0 -> '$0.00', -500 -> '-$5.00'
convert uses the rates in inputs/rates_2026-11-02.csv, the official rate table finance publishes; no other rates may be used
convert returns whole cents, rounded half up
